unit: Local currency / kWh (effective average; detail in C4a–e)

question: C4a — What is the **electricity billing type** for lighting-related consumption?
unit: Flat (single rate) / Time-of-use (TOU) / Multi-tier or other (describe)

question: C4b — **Peak** (or highest tier) **electricity price** per kWh — use when TOU or peak tier applies; otherwise enter N/A.
C4c — **Off-peak** **electricity price** per kWh — use when TOU applies; otherwise enter N/A.
C4d — **Shoulder / mid-peak** **electricity price** per kWh — if your utility uses three or more periods; otherwise enter N/A.
C4e — For **TOU / multi-tier**: provide either **(1)** clock **time windows** for peak / off-peak / shoulder, **or** **(2)** approximate **% of annual kWh** in each bucket.
unit: Time windows and/or % of annual kWh by period

question: C5 — How many hours per night are the lights currently on?
